data.long_meaning: Ankurita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ankur' meaning 'seed'. This name is given to a girl symbolizing the beginning of a new life, growth, and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Ankurita is believed to bring blessings of fertility, prosperity, and success. The name Ankurita carries the meaning “Seeder, Planter” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ankurita usually hope their child will grow to embody seeder, planter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
